units: pixels (x right, y down, origin top-left) and seconds; no metric scale assumed

camera.evidence: phase correlation of wall patch (x1000-1900, y50-450) vs frame 0: |shift| <= 0.01 px in all 40 frames (cam_dx, cam_dy columns in tracks/gift_box.csv)
camera.view: looking roughly horizontally at a grey breeze-block wall; blue slide/ramp runs from upper-left (near the crates) diagonally down to the lower-right, ending on a wooden floor/platform; ramp also comes slightly toward the camera as it descends (box grows ~8% linear size along the slide)

perspective_cues.wall: fronto-parallel-ish brick wall, mortar rows nearly horizontal -> image rows ~ horizontal world direction
perspective_cues.ramp_far_edge_line: points (760,562) -> (1440,974); image slope dy/dx = 0.606 (31.2 deg below horizontal)
perspective_cues.ramp_top_end_edge: approx horizontal at y ~537 from x ~255 to ~720
perspective_cues.horizon: not visible; camera roughly level (wall mortar lines horizontal)

objects.name: gift_box
objects.description: white wrapped gift box with yellow ribbon cross and yellow bow on top; the ONLY moving object
objects.reference_point: body_cx, body_cy = centroid of the convex hull of the white paper (bow excluded) = best estimate of the projected box centre/origin; cx, cy = centroid of the full silhouette incl. bow (~6 px higher)

apparent_size_px.note: box is tilted (rotated ~20-30 deg in image) so bbox is larger than a face; the box is roughly a cube; bow adds ~18 px on top. sqrt(area) grows ~8% from frame 0 to 38 (moving toward camera).

objects.occlusion: none; frame 39 bottom of box is cut by the image bottom edge (truncated_by_frame_edge=1)

objects.name: slide_ramp
objects.description: blue inclined slide / roller conveyor with blue side rails and dark mottled surface, from upper-left (behind crates, top end y~537) down to lower-right where it meets the wooden floor (~x1420-1460, y~990); near rail runs out of the bottom of the frame

objects.name: support_post
objects.description: blue vertical post under the top end of the ramp, left of image
objects.note: bottom cut by frame edge; upper part hidden by ramp/crate

objects.name: cardboard_box_rome_italy
objects.description: brown cardboard box printed 'PRODUCT OF ROME ITALY ... CERONA FOODS', top-left corner, cut by left and top frame edges

objects.name: crate_seedless_jaffas
objects.description: light wooden crate printed 'SEEDLESS JAFFAS / ZIMBABWE ORANGES' with red '6/72' label, under the brown box, left edge; the slide starts at its right side
objects.note: cut by left frame edge; visual estimate +-5 px

objects.name: wooden_shelf_board
objects.description: light wood board under the crate at the ramp top, y~535-575, x 0-255

objects.name: warning_sign
objects.description: orange sign 'TAKE CARE WHEN STACKING CRATES' on the wall, right of centre

objects.name: wooden_floor
objects.description: light wooden floor / pallet platform with bolts, bottom right, where the ramp ends

objects.name: brick_wall
objects.description: grey breeze-block wall filling the background; blocks ~140 px wide x ~95-100 px tall near the sign (mortar rows ~ y 50,150,...)

events.note: frame0->1 displacement only 1.9 px, increments then grow ~3.7-3.9 px/frame each frame: free fall from (near) rest at t~0
between frames 8 and 9 the box hits the ramp surface (frame 8 last free-fall frame, dy 28.1 px; frame 9 dy 9.1 px with dx 7.6 px). No visible bounce.
direction ~ along ramp, image slope dy/dx ~0.6; per-frame pixel step grows 11.8 -> 54.7 px

events.event: end of clip, box near lower end of ramp, partly out of frame
